I added `GET /api/v1/items/stats`. I didn't run the tests or the app, so none of it has been run.

- **Response:** it returns `{"count": int, "newest_title": str | null}`. A regular user gets the number of items they own and the title of their newest one, with `null` if they have none. Superusers get the same two values across all items.
- **Route:** `read_items_stats` in `backend/app/api/routes/items.py`. It is declared before `/{id}`, so "stats" isn't parsed as an item ID.
- **Database access:** the new `get_items_stats` in `backend/app/crud.py` does the queries, so the route doesn't touch the session, as your rules require. "Newest" is ordered by `created_at`, with `id` as a tie-breaker.
- **Schema:** a new `ItemsStats` model in `backend/app/models.py`.

The new code uses no status code literals.

You need to regenerate the frontend client with `bash scripts/generate-client.sh`, since the API schema changed. I skipped it because it needs the app running. I also didn't add a test for the endpoint.
